title: UI风格#86 - Cyberpunk Corporate (企业赛博朋克)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Corporate style When color palette Then features corporate blue, neon pink, slate gray, chrome
Given Cyberpunk Corporate style When typography Then uses corporate tech: Montserrat, Roboto Mono, or Poppins
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Montserrat (headers 2.6rem 800 weight), Roboto Mono (body 0.9rem 400-500 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Corporate style When layout Then corporate towers, holographic ads, busy streets
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: corporate grid overlay, holographic scan line animation, neon pink/cyan/blue gradient border, corporate dark aesthetic

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Corporate style When UI elements Then corporate logos, neon signs, digital billboards
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: holoScan keyframe animation, neonPulse glow animation, corp-blue/neon-pink/cyber-cyan gradient accents, dark corporate background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Corporate UI When functional Then includes corp chat, exec agents, profit stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: strategy hub chat, 4 exec agents (Matrix/Nexus/Vapor/Binary) with Profit/QO/Synergy/Growth/Scalable/Disrupt/Uptime/Load stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Cyberpunk Corporate UI When copy Then uses corporate future: 'Synergy', 'Optimize', 'Scalable', 'Disrupt'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SYNERGY. OPTIMIZE. DISRUPT.', tagline 'CORPORATE SOLUTIONS DIVISION', button 'PITCH', greeting 'Neural link established', status 'Online'/'Idle', nav 'Corp'/'Systems'/'Metrics'/'Command'
